scoring_justification: T1 feasible: the agent's raw time-series, distance profiles, and energy tables allow recomputation of the paper's key quantities (final angle, monotonic distance profile, energy magnitude and dominance) without needing the simulation trajectory.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values, tolerances, and expected ranges for MD adsorption results, used by the checker to score reproducibility.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper: angle stabilises at ~78° (Fig. 4A, Section 3.1), base-pair distances increase from 0.1 nm to 3.4 nm (Fig. 4B), total interaction energy ~-120 kJ/mol, vdW ~-105 to -140 kJ/mol, electrostatic ~-15 to 15 kJ/mol (Fig. 6, Table 1), control system angles ~78° for altered sequence, and 65°–75° for shorter DNA (Section 3.3).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values and ranges taken directly from paper text/figures. Tolerances set to accommodate reasonable MD re-implementation spread while excluding physically implausible results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold numbers are directly traced to the paper's reported results and qualitative conclusions; no synthetic or guessed values are used.

outputs.description: Time evolution of the angle between the ds-DNA main axis and the MoS₂ surface for the two main orientations.
Average distance from the centre of mass of each base pair to the MoS₂ surface during the last 15 ns of the main simulations.
Van der Waals and electrostatic interaction energies between DNA and MoS₂ for residues within 4 Å of the surface.
Final equilibrium adsorption angles for all five systems (two main orientations, altered sequence, 8 bp, 6 bp).

output_contract.notes: All outputs are scored by comparing computed quantities to hidden reference values with per-artifact tolerances. Angles, distances, energies, and stability metrics must match the paper's reported trends and approximate values.
